verdict.rationale: The firm's own late-stage company page describes deep expertise in helping private companies achieve strong M&A outcomes and in preparing for an IPO. A dedicated D&O Questionnaire Portal page supports companies going public and after they are public, and client news lists an exit transaction (the Hugging Face sale to NVIDIA). missing for 10: dedicated M&A and IPO practice pages with deal counts or track-record metrics, named company-side IPO representations, and independent corroboration of exit experience.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm can carry the company through to exit — M&A and public-offering experience for venture-backed companies is documented on its own pages

citations.quote: we have deep expertise helping private companies achieve the best possible M&A outcomes. ... Preparations for an IPO typically get underway two years in advance of the offering itself.

The D&O Questionnaire Portal is a web-based, tech-forward tool designed to simplify and streamline the process of completing the Director and Officer (D&O) questionnaires used by companies when going public and after as public companies.
Gunderson Dettmer Represents Addition and Lux Capital in Hugging Face Sale to NVIDIA for $12.9 Billion
